description:
Power, Range, and All-Terrain Comfort
The V20 Pro Electric Bike is built for riders seeking strong acceleration, extended range, and confident control across city streets and mixed terrain. Its 1000W rated brushless motor delivers up to 1500W peak output, while the removable 48V 18.2Ah battery supports a maximum assisted range of up to 80 miles under ideal riding conditions.
Full suspension, 20 × 4.0 inch fat tires, and Logan hydraulic disc brakes provide a comfortable and controlled riding experience across pavement, gravel, trails, and uneven surfaces. A Shimano 7-speed drivetrain and upgraded rear cargo rack add everyday versatility for commuting, recreation, and carrying essential gear.

Why Choose the V20 Pro Electric Bike?

1500W Peak Brushless MotorThe 1000W rated motor delivers up to 1500W peak output and 90 N·m of torque, providing responsive acceleration and confident climbing performance.

48V 18.2Ah Removable BatteryThe high-capacity removable battery supports longer journeys, with a maximum assisted range of up to 80 miles under ideal riding conditions.

Logan Hydraulic Disc BrakesHydraulic disc brakes provide strong and responsive stopping power, improving control during city riding, higher-speed travel, and downhill sections.

Full-Suspension ComfortFront and rear suspension help absorb bumps and road vibration, providing a smoother and more comfortable ride across varied surfaces.

20 × 4.0 Inch All-Terrain Fat TiresWide fat tires improve grip, balance, and stability across pavement, gravel, grass, sand, and other mixed riding surfaces.

Shimano 7-Speed DrivetrainThe Shimano 7-speed gear system provides smooth mechanical shifting and greater flexibility for different speeds, gradients, and riding conditions.

50 lb Rear Cargo RackThe upgraded rear rack provides practical carrying capacity for bags, groceries, commuting essentials, and recreational gear.

Who Is the V20 Pro Electric Bike For?

Long-Distance CommutersIdeal for riders who want a high-capacity battery, practical cargo space, and dependable electric assistance for regular journeys.

Riders Seeking Extra PowerA strong choice for riders who value responsive acceleration, higher torque, and confident performance across hills and varied terrain.

Comfort-Focused RidersFull suspension, wide fat tires, and a long moped-style seat help provide a stable and comfortable riding experience.

All-Terrain Recreational RidersSuitable for exploring paved roads, gravel paths, grass, sand, and light off-road terrain while maintaining dependable grip and control.

Utility and Everyday RidersThe rear cargo rack and 330 lb maximum load capacity make the V20 Pro suitable for commuting, shopping, carrying gear, and weekend riding.

Motor Power
1000W Rated / 1500W Peak Brushless Motor

Maximum Range
Up to 80 Miles in Pedal-Assist Mode

Maximum Speed
Up to 32 mph, Where Local Regulations Permit

Tire Size
20 × 4.0 Inch All-Terrain Fat Tires

Net Weight
103 lb / 46.7 kg, Including Battery

Rear Rack Capacity
Up to 50 lb / 22.7 kg

Additional Equipment
Horn, Rear Reflector, and Aluminium Alloy Kickstand

Maximum speed and range figures are based on manufacturer testing. Actual performance may vary depending on rider weight, assistance level, terrain, weather, temperature, tire pressure, and riding conditions.
